assets.prompt: Edit this exact sprite to REMOVE THE ENTIRE BACKGROUND. Keep this exact happy full-body Emu character and every costume/head/detail/pose unchanged. Output must be a transparent PNG cutout with actual alpha=0 pixels everywhere outside her crisp outline. REMOVE the black backdrop, all pink glows, all blurred aura, all gradients, all cast shadow and every environmental pixel. Do NOT draw a new colored background or any checkerboard. No glow around her. A clean isolated game sprite on genuine transparent alpha only, not an illustration with a backdrop. Preserve portrait 2:3 canvas, unchanged proportions and feet baseline. No words.
assets.baseGenerationPrompt: Create ONE production game sprite, not a sheet: a newly illustrated full-body super-deformed chibi Otori Emu from Project SEKAI, HAPPY IDLE pose. The first attached image is her identity/head reference; second is the companion character style reference only and must NOT appear. Pink bob hair, purple-pink eyes, joyful open simple smile. Approximately two heads tall with a very large recognizable round head, tiny fully drawn body, rounded mitten hands and boots. Original simplified pink-and-white Wonderlands x Showtime stage outfit: pink puff-sleeved dress, white apron/bib with a small yellow bow, white frills, pink shoes. Childlike cartoon proportions with modest fully clothed outfit. Dark plum clean medium outlines and soft cel shading matching the reference, professionally polished Japanese mobile-game SD sprite. Facing slightly to viewer's RIGHT (will stand on the left side of game). Both arms relaxed, friendly happy idle stance, both feet planted on same level. Portrait 2:3 canvas. Entire character, including hair and shoes, inside central 84% of the canvas; fixed foot baseline 93% height, head near 8%. TRUE transparent alpha background with no solid backdrop, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no shadow on ground. No other characters, no words, symbols, bubble, border, watermark or panel. This is the first of a consistent eight-pose sprite set. Output a single clean transparent PNG sprite.
